advice: Propose a 16-row fused A-pack/MOPA microtile in the full512 assembly, replacing the pack-then-compute region beginning at Llibxsmm_78 and Llibxsmm_440. For each 16-row A panel, load the corresponding 16×512 row-major A tile in the current ZA transpose layout, transpose it in ZA, and feed each 16-row slice directly to the existing four ZA.S accumulators across all 16 output-column tiles and 512 K steps. Keep only a 16×512 FP32 scratch tile (32 KiB) at a time. This reduces scratch written from 128 KiB to 32 KiB per 64-row band, but repeats A transpose work: the original packs 64 rows once per band, while this design packs 16 rows four times per band, so total A transpose/load work across the GEMM is unchanged if every row is packed once; the packing is interleaved with compute instead of completed up front. Preserve B/C traversal, FP32 K order, beta-zero stores, one SME entry, general-size fallback, and full license notices. This requires coordinated changes to the assembly packing and compute loops, scratch strides/rewinds, and row-band traversal; it is source-expressible without a new generated shape, but the register/ZA mapping and pointer schedule need careful design. It is a hypothesis, not a measured gain.
risks: The proposal changes a long generated assembly body and has high implementation risk. ZA holds transpose state before reuse as accumulators, so each microtile must finish packing before zeroing or repurposing ZA. Scratch consumers must read exactly the 16-row packed panel, with no stale or out-of-bounds access. Incorrect C row offsets or B/C rewinds can omit or overwrite output rows. The smaller scratch footprint may reduce live data movement, but does not reduce the total A elements loaded or transposed; any benefit could be offset by added loop/control work or worse reuse. Validate assembly and ABI, full n=512 GEMM against the 0.002 tolerance, fresh inputs/output overwrite, non-512 sizes including tails and n<=0, and timed paired controls under the unchanged power mode and settings. Retain the incumbent unless the fixed repeated promotion gates pass; do not infer cause from noisy scores.
